description: Discover a domain's public subdomains (app., api., staging., and so on) from Certificate Transparency logs, querying crt.sh and Cert Spotter in parallel and returning whichever answers first. Useful for mapping a company's public attack surface or infrastructure. If both sources are down the call returns an error rather than an empty list.
